source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: AddressBookStore.create starts CardDAV fetch after creating the book but does not await the remote population. In D205784 the reviewer suggested awaiting it; the author explained that a server failure or an hour-long fetch should not block syncing other items, and the suggestion was not applied. The rejected review request is an explicit behavior decision: Sync creates the book record, then remote content population proceeds separately and catches errors.
title: Let CardDAV population continue after Sync creates the address book
